title: Perimeter
summary: Johnny makes V run a timed scavenger walk through a Santo Domingo cul-de-sac, calling out three vantage points.

start.bringUp: Johnny wants to see how V would hold a cul-de-sac. Bring up, in your own way and grumpy, a walk through the Rancho Coronado cul-de-sac in Santo Domingo with three points to reach in eight game minutes.

hedge.name: a hedge at the mouth of a Rancho Coronado cul-de-sac

garage.name: the roof of a garage on the cul-de-sac, the second point

mailbox.name: a corner mailbox at the far end of the cul-de-sac

g1.asks: Would you live here? Honest. Fence, lawn, and everyone knows your car.
g1.know: The timer is running, a barbecue neighbour has V's ear, and Johnny cannot talk to the neighbour.
g1.secret: He almost lived like this once.
g1.wants: V to answer fast and move on.

stages.label: Reach the three points in eight game minutes
stages.know: Johnny calls out three vantage points in order: a hedge, a garage roof and a corner mailbox. You have eight game minutes, and a neighbour at a barbecue may stop V at the garage roof.
stages.wants: V to reach the three points in order before the time runs out.

perfect.memory: You walked a Santo Domingo cul-de-sac in eight game minutes, reaching all three points Johnny called out.

walk-of-shame.memory: You ran Johnny's cul-de-sac walk too slowly, and he called it a walk of shame.

variations.know: It is dawn with light fog. The second point is the school-bus stop, not the garage roof.
It is night and the sprinklers are on. The points are a trash can, a parked truck and an upstairs window.
It is raining and the neighbours stay indoors. The twist is a leaf blower left running beside a fence.
